steps.title: Open the Dashboard
steps.narration: The home screen loads with no errors. The readiness pill in the top-right shows green and says 'Ready'.
steps.point_out: The small pill in the top-right corner and the absence of a loud red banner below the header — both confirm the backend is healthy and responsive.

steps.title: Navigate to Data Manager
steps.narration: Click the Data Manager link in the sidebar to go to the job-control page.
steps.point_out: The readiness pill stays green and the form appears with pre-filled date fields ready for a backfill job.

steps.title: Check the job history and refreshed categories
steps.narration: Scroll down or look at an existing run to see the 'Refreshed:' line, which lists all the categories computed during the most recent ingest.
steps.point_out: The list of categories (e.g. coverage, research hot keys, factor lab all) confirms aggregates were precomputed at ingest time, not fetched on demand.

steps.title: Open Factor Lab to check research data
steps.narration: Navigate to the Factor Lab page to see the latest research scoring results.
steps.point_out: A sortable table with real factor rows (Leadership, etc.) shows that research data is intact after the backend scheduling change.

steps.title: Sort the Factor Lab table to confirm responsiveness
steps.narration: Click the 'N' column header to re-order the rows by sample size.
steps.point_out: Rows re-order instantly with no page reload or error, showing the data is correctly computed and accessible.

steps.title: Expand a factor row to see the decile breakdown
steps.narration: Click the first factor row to reveal its decile detail grid (D1 through D10).
steps.point_out: The decile grid renders without error, confirming all research computations are complete and cacheable.

steps.title: Navigate back to Data Manager
steps.narration: Return to the Data Manager page to check the badge behavior during normal operations.
steps.point_out: The readiness pill is still green — it renders consistently across all pages and never gets stuck in an error state.

steps.title: Confirm the readiness badge recovered and stays healthy
steps.narration: Look at the top-right header pill one final time to confirm the backend state displays correctly.
steps.point_out: The pill reads 'Ready' with a solid green dot. This concludes the tour — the product remains healthy, data flows normally, and the header state accurately reflects the backend's availability.
